}}'''Aquatism''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Temples|Water Temple]] and grants a [[Defence Bonus|defence bonus]] to friendly [[units]] on water and ocean tiles.



==Polarism==
[[Polaris]] has the '''Polarism''' technology instead of Aquatism. Polarism unlocks the [[Temples|Ice Temple]] and the Glide ability, which makes moving onto ice tiles cost half a move for all non-skating units, functionally similar to to how roads work. Moving from an ice tile to a onto a non-ice tile, even if it has a road, still costs one full [[Movement|move]].
